title: Soroban Governance Parser — normalized output schema v1
description: Single source of truth shared by soroban-governance-parser, governance-event-indexer and delegate-portal-dashboard. Bumping this version requires a schema.lock update in every consumer repo.

decodingStatus.description: verified = names checked against contractspecv0; unverified = raw ScVal passthrough. Fail-closed: never default to verified.

riskTier.description: Output of the published rule table in crates/core/src/risk.rs. Data, not a verdict.

matched_rule.description: The exact published rule (or the exact reason for unverified). Always present so classifications are auditable.

verified.description: true only when the function name came from a verified contract spec.

arguments.description: Named object when decoding=verified; positional array when decoding=unverified.

governor.description: Adapter id (e.g. script3-soroban-governor) or the literal string 'unverified'. Never guessed.

executionImpact.description: Dry-run output. estimate is ALWAYS true in v1 (charter rule 5): simulation runs against the current ledger, not the future execution ledger.

state_changes.description: null when the RPC did not return state changes. Absence is meaningful; never defaulted to empty-success.
